block_x.design: 4x4 Williams square over C/Wa/Wb/P2 (rc.williams(4), index 0=C,1=Wa,2=Wb,3=P2); round r: classes fill,toggle (r even) or toggle,fill (r odd); row (r + class index) mod 4 (fill 0, toggle 1); rounds 0-15 (4 squares, 16 rounds per class); no modal, no smoke (smoke passed 5/5 per class in the main block)

gates_block_x.NC_AA: median paired (Wa - Wb) within [-1.0, +1.0] ms AND 95% CI includes 0
gates_block_x.PC2: 95% CI of median paired (P2 - Wa) excludes 0 AND median in [12, 18] ms
gates_block_x.validity: every block-x cell (C, Wa, Wb, P2) >= 95% valid
gates_block_x.smoke: taken from the main block (5/5 per class required)

amended_verdict_rule: fill and toggle each, on block x only: if any gate fails -> UNDECIDED naming it; else D = median paired (C - Wa), D' = median paired (C - Wb) must agree in sign; D >= 1.0 ms with CI excluding 0 -> OWNER_DECISION sized D; CI(D) strictly inside (-1, +1) -> NOT_MATERIAL (per-process IRREDUCIBLE); else UNDECIDED. Block-x numbers are never pooled with main-block numbers.
